# Bali Belly Recovery

> Specialist Bali Belly medical service by DripWell Bali. Doctor and nurse home-visit requests are accepted 24/7; each visit is subject to address confirmation, clinical assessment and team availability.

## Facts
- Searching for Bali Belly near me: send a WhatsApp location pin; a doctor and nurse come to your villa or hotel.
- Service: Bali Belly doctor and nurse home visit, IV therapy and medication, medical report for travel insurance
- Appointment requests: accepted 24/7; visit availability and estimated arrival time are confirmed for the exact address.
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 822 2161 4966, dripwellbali@gmail.com
- Packages (normal prices): Essential Rp 2.025.000; Bali Belly + Tablet Medication Rp 2.275.000; Complete Rp 2.525.000.
- Active offer: 15% off the three packages with code SAVE15. Promo prices: Rp 1.721.250; Rp 1.933.750; Rp 2.146.250 respectively. Confirm the current offer when booking.
- Covered areas (15): Canggu, Kerobokan & Umalas, Dalung, Seminyak, Legian, Kuta, Munggu & Cemagi, Kedungu & Tanah Lot, Tabanan, Uluwatu & Pecatu, Jimbaran, Nusa Dua & Benoa, Sanur, Denpasar, Ubud. Send a WhatsApp location pin to confirm arrival time.
- Go to the nearest emergency room for fainting, blood in stool or vomit, severe abdominal pain, very high fever, or inability to keep fluids down.
